exposure: number of previous Cesarean Scar Pregnancies (CSPs)
interval between the last cesarean section and the current CSP
cohort: The study included 143 women with type 1 Cesarean Scar Pregnancy (CSP) and 200 women with type 2 CSP, diagnosed between January 2020 and July 2023.
finding: Women with more than 3 prior cesarean sections had an increased risk of developing type 1 Cesarean Scar Pregnancy (CSP), while vaginal bleeding before diagnosis was more frequently associated with type 2 CSP, despite both subtypes sharing many clinical characteristics and having limited distinguishing clinical risk factors.
mod_finding: Women with more than 3 prior cesarean sections had an increased risk of developing type 1 Cesarean Scar Pregnancy.
